description: Site-wide TraceCore feature switches (A-06 I7). Only TC R10 and System Manager can change them; every change is written to the Audit Log.

fields.description: Allow assigning laser-etched GS1 GIAI codes to single instruments (FR-M1-02). Turning it off keeps existing codes and does not affect T1-T7.
fields.label: Enable Instrument GIAI

fields.description: A TC R02 user who may approve or reject par overrides on behalf of R01 (FR-M8-04.1). Leave empty to let only R01 decide.
fields.label: Par Override Delegate (R02)

fields.description: Send SMS for notification rules that use the SMS channel (FR-M9-10). Off until the hospital SMS gateway is configured.
fields.label: Enable SMS

fields.description: HTTPS endpoint of the SMS gateway. TraceCore posts JSON {to, text, sender}; any 2xx answer counts as sent.
fields.label: SMS Gateway URL

fields.description: Times of day (HH:MM, comma separated) at which a monitored zone with no reading since the previous time is reminded (FR-M9-04.2). Leave empty to turn reminders off.
fields.label: Environment Reminder Times

fields.description: Warn when this share of the maximum storage time has passed (FR-M10-03.3). Default 80.
fields.label: Storage Warning (%)

fields.description: Hours above the limit before bags go back to the normal storage time (FR-M10-03.2). Default 2.
fields.label: Hours Above the Limit

fields.description: A larger difference between collected and handed over weight needs a reason and R02 approval (FR-M10-04.1). Default 5.
fields.label: Handover Weight Difference (%)

fields.description: This many misclassifications of a department within the days below alert R01 (FR-M10-06.2). Default 3.
fields.label: Repeated Misclassification Count

fields.description: A daily weight this far from the department average alerts R02 (FR-M10-08.1). Default 30.
fields.label: Unusual Department Weight (%)

fields.description: Which sterilizers must pass a daily test before loading. Other machines are never locked or blocked for a daily test. A change applies at once.
fields.label: Daily Test Requirement
fields.options:
Not Required
All Sterilizers
Selected Sterilizers

fields.description: Steam sterilizers must also pass a leak test each day, besides the Bowie-Dick test.
fields.label: Require Leak Test

fields.description: Plasma sterilizers must pass a daily test according to the hospital rules.
fields.label: Require Plasma Daily Test

fields.description: Reports and the sterilization log of a period ending on or before this date are final; later periods are printed with a PROVISIONAL stamp (FR-M9-02.1). Only TC R01 sets it, with Lock Report Period on the reports.
fields.label: Reports Locked Until

name: TraceCore Settings
